entities.summary: Tetyana Cherep-Perohanych (b. 1974-11-18, Tymky) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tymky and Ukraine. Known in the fields of ukraine, poets & playwrights, europe.
